description: This line plot illustrates the average repetition rate of words between generated training samples (with K=32) across 64 distinct relation categories, comparing three experimental conditions: “w/o DPO obo” (blue solid line with circle markers), “w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint” (orange solid line with triangle markers), and “DPO” (green solid line with square markers). The x-axis, labeled “Relation Category,” is linear and spans integer values from 0 to 64, with major gridlines and tick labels at intervals of 10. The y-axis, labeled “Average Repetition Rate,” is linear and ranges from 0.0 to 0.6, with major gridlines at 0.1 intervals. The blue line (“w/o DPO obo”) exhibits high variability, with a sharp peak near 0.6 at category 32 and frequent fluctuations between 0.05 and 0.45. The orange line (“w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint”) also fluctuates widely, peaking near 0.6 at category 32 and reaching 0.47 at category 55, with values often exceeding 0.2. The green line (“DPO”) remains consistently low and stable, mostly between 0.08 and 0.15, rarely exceeding 0.2. Dashed lines indicate the overall average for each condition: 0.163 for “w/o DPO obo,” 0.227 for “w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint,” and 0.117 for “DPO,” visually confirming that the DPO method yields the lowest average repetition rate across all categories.
